# seerr_watchlist (Data Source)

Fetch watchlist items for the authenticated user or a specific user in Seerr.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `user_id` (Number) Optional target user ID. Omit to fetch authenticated user's watchlist.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier.
- `total` (Number) Total number of watchlist items found.
- `watchlist` (Attributes List) List of watchlist items. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--watchlist))

<a id="nestedatt--watchlist"></a>
### Nested Schema for `watchlist`

Read-Only:

- `media_type` (String) Media type (`movie` or `tv`).
- `overview` (String) Media summary/overview.
- `title` (String) Title of media item.
- `tmdb_id` (Number) TMDB numeric media ID.
